name: Codacy
one_line: Opt-in pull request reviewer on GitHub that combines Codacy's static analysis with a language model, reads the PR, linked Jira or Linear tickets and repository instructions, and posts a review with a verdict, a summary, test suggestions and inline comments with suggested fixes. It can run automatically on the first review of a PR or on demand (button or public API).
note: Everything here is from public pages. Facts carry their source and the time they were read; the hypothesis and the suggestions are ours and say so. GAMMA-Ray is a beta standard: every rating is experimental.

help.pitch: RiskMandate would measure, for one real deployment of Codacy's agents, what each agent was asked to do (its mandate), what its credentials and connections actually let it reach (its grant), and the difference between the two (the gap), and keep that as a written record. It is read-only: never in the request path.
